summary: In this excerpt from Book 2 (part 131) of a fiction serial, the narrator confronts Dawna Polk, who has manipulated Tresting into betraying them. Dawna coolly admits that if Rio is not on their side she will cut losses, and she taunts Tresting about returning to her side. Tresting is wrecked by guilt and vomits, while the narrator jokes and insists she trusts Rio completely, so Dawna's claim that Rio will kill her seems absurd.
one_line: Dawna Polk manipulates Tresting into betrayal, and the narrator, Ms. Russell, refuses to believe Rio would ever turn on her.
key_facts: Dawna Polk tells Ms. Russell that if Rio is not on their side, it would be time to cut their losses.
Dawna tells Tresting that she can bring him around to their point of view again quite easily.
Tresting declares that he will never trust another word Dawna says.
Dawna says Tresting would come back to them in a heartbeat as soon as she wished.
Dawna puts a hand to her temple and says it has been a trying few days.
Arthur asks what Dawna is going to do, and the narrator says she is going to have Rio kill her.
Arthur vomits and mumbles that the betrayal is his fault because she convinced him.
The narrator warns Arthur that if he ever sells out Rio again, she will kill him.
The narrator says she is not panicking and compares Dawna's claim to insisting that pi equals three.
The narrator states she trusts Rio completely, so Dawna's claim that Rio would kill her is like insisting black is white or one equals two.
Dawna says she will return shortly after the conversation.

entities.name: Dawna Polk
entities.role: manipulative antagonist who persuades Tresting and threatens Ms. Russell's life

entities.name: Tresting
entities.role: character who was seduced by Dawna and then turns back, guilt-stricken

entities.name: Arthur
entities.role: character, apparently the same as Tresting, who is horrified and vomits after realizing his betrayal

entities.name: Ms. Russell
entities.role: narrator who is threatened by Dawna and trusts Rio

entities.name: Rio
entities.role: friend of the narrator, whom Dawna claims could be turned against her
